clusters.name: Represent an unresolved contrast, then extend descriptive state
Build operational relations from procedures and substitutions
Learn conditions under which evidence becomes observable
Revise construction languages and maintain partial correspondences
Produce contrasts before predicting their informational value
Learn experimental habits and preserve access to future experiments
Learn readers through observed changes to a memory carrier
Preserve constraints that teach a future reader
Calibrate use of a reader or reopen acquisition

secondary_links.reason: An executable test can become the descriptive primitive that resolves a contrast.
A descriptive gap requests an experiment before a world hypothesis exists.
Reopening experimental opportunities can restore access to evidence.
A changing construction language can be specialized to learned reader repair.
Trial future-reader behavior can inform which explicit teaching memory survives.
An external contrast can calibrate a reader, with reacquisition counted separately.
Old questions retain unresolved translations when descriptive state changes.

proposed_directions.name: Convert unresolved contrast to executable descriptive primitive
proposed_directions.learned_object: Operational predicate or history-state component constructed from permitted encounters
must_expose: Initial test grammar and tokenization
Learner-generated failure obligation without hidden-factor hints
Passive test versus invasive procedure semantics
Unresolved distinctions and limited empirical support

proposed_directions.name: Learn reusable substitution roles from acquired action procedures
proposed_directions.learned_object: Context-qualified equivalence and boundary relations among acquired procedure fragments
must_expose: Enumeration of candidate boundaries and exchanges
Operational consequences actually compared
Participant identities supplied by interface versus roles learned
Limits of context coverage and failed compositions

proposed_directions.name: Learn experiment-building habits from the revisions they enable
proposed_directions.learned_object: Reusable procedure compositions, mutations and empirical access relations
must_expose: Actual update that creates executable experiment structure
Delayed credit definition beyond raw count of new predicates
Generator prior and future-demand family
Executed observations distinguished from modeled outcomes

proposed_directions.name: Learn evidence restoration and distinguish measurement from intervention
proposed_directions.learned_object: Empirical procedure relations governing which contrasts become observable
must_expose: Actual action and measurement controls available
Effects of learner-produced conditions
Untested combinations and unresolved attribution
Difference between signal variability and decision-relevant knowledge

proposed_directions.name: Learn reader construction through observed carrier changes
proposed_directions.learned_object: Reusable reading-program fragments or a learned search process
must_expose: Reading language and artificial-change prior
All copies probes stored answers constraints histories and search weights
Target checks that cannot import withheld old answers
Retained-only decoding versus renewed acquisition
Carrier contribution after retained check material is held fixed

selection_rationale: Diagnostic relevance and diversity of changes to acquired predicates, substitution relations, experiment procedures, evidence access and reader construction. This is not a novelty or feasibility ranking.
nonselected_disposition: Preserved without retirement; no raw entry rejected by this consultation.
